subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 grouped action updates after a single permission and supply-chain review, or require the credentialed and publishing actions to be split into narrower PRs?
rationale: These official immutable pins appear structurally sound, but several execute with secrets or write permissions, and repository policy reserves that security-boundary acceptance for a human owner.

options.title: Approve verified group
options.body: Accept the grouped update after confirming every SHA and reviewing the privileged upstream changes on the exact rebased head.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token generation, container publishing, CodeQL, and Codex action updates from routine toolchain setup pins for narrower proof.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Keep the current pins and wait for narrower replacement PRs if owners cannot confidently review this grouped security surface.

recommendation.title: Approve verified group
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update after confirming every SHA and reviewing the privileged upstream changes on the exact rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from direct PR engagement and recent CI/security workflow history.
